Agent-facing instructions for this repository.

## Project

This repo builds and ships the `tsup` / `tsup-node` CLI binaries.

## Install

Use the package manager already declared by the repo lockfile.

```bash
pnpm install
```

```bash
pnpm build
```

```bash
pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
```
